judges: Prasenjit Mandal Sri Prabir Kishore Chakravarty. J.
trial_court: Additional District Judge, 14th Court, Alipore, Matrimonial Suit No.1565 of 2008 (renumbered as Matrimonial Suit No.78 of 2009)
case_name: Sri Prabir Kishore Chakravarty vs Smt. Soma Chakravarty
facts_of_case: The husband preferred a matrimonial suit for divorce before the learned District Judge, Alipore. The wife did not contest the suit and it was decreed ex parte on June 29, 2009. Thereafter, the wife filed an application under Order 9 Rule 13 of the C.P.C. which was converted into Misc. Case No.16 of 2009.

legal_principles.principle: No court shall set aside a decree passed ex parte merely on the ground of irregularity in the service of summons.
legal_principles.held: It is not the case that no summons was ever served upon her, but she had no knowledge of the date of hearing of the said suit.
cited_cases: Mahabir Singh v. Subhas & Ors, (2008) 1 SCC 358

legal_principles.principle: A court shall not set aside a decree passed ex parte if the defendant had notice of the date of hearing and had sufficient time to appear and answer the plaintiff's claim.
legal_principles.held: No Court shall set aside a decree passed ex parte merely on the ground that there has been an irregularity in the service of summons, if it is satisfied that the defendant had notice of the date of hearing and had sufficient time to appear and answer the plaintiff's claim.
cited_cases: Mahabir Singh v. Subhas & Ors, (2008) 1 SCC 358

outcome.final_order: The ex parte decree for divorce passed on June 29, 2009 has been set aside.

use_for_drafting: responding to opposition in matrimonial suit
